items.title: Anthropic shares close 17% higher on first day of trading
items.text: The shares ended the session at around $97, up from an IPO price of $83, after opening at $111.50 and briefly valuing the maker of the Claude chatbot at about $2 trillion

items.title: Nearing 3 years as Rajasthan CM, Bhajan Lal Sharma seeks to assert his authority
items.text: Having entered office with virtually no administrative experience, his tenure has been a continuous tightrope walk between balancing the demands of the party’s central leadership and build authority of his own within the State.

items.title: Nashik Court grants bail to Imtiaz Jaleel in TCS case on ₹50,000 bond
items.text: When Mr. Jaleel sought bail, the state opposed, but the court granted release on bond since the sections allow bail

items.title: Draft of COP31 cover text drops references to fossil fuel phase-out, net zero dates
items.text: COP31 draft cover text omits fossil fuel phase-out, net-zero dates, and $120B adaptation finance goals, signaling diluted ambitions and stalled commitments.

items.title: Anthropic raises $81 billion in IPO amid AI market volatility
items.text: The Claude maker priced its shares at $83 apiece, implying an equity valuation of about $1.03 trillion based on outstanding shares, with trading scheduled to begin on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT on November 19
